description: scripts/ui-flows/scene-physics-template.json drives param 31_pos_x (the old water domain transform). On main the domain has no transform; the Initial Fill row owns the box position. Red on origin/main. Fix: select the Initial Fill row and drive its transform rows.

title: scene-two-panes flow stale: default split lands at y=400, flow expects 424
description: scripts/ui-flows/scene-two-panes.json step 13 (after DoubleClick on scene_setup.split) expects the split strip at y=424 but it is at 400. Fails identically on base a53314510 (built and run separately), so independent of the SceneNodeRef lane. The flow is only triggered by panes.rs edits, so the later outliner changes (group headings, one Add menu) never re-ran it. Fix: re-record the expected rect.

title: test_run_ui_flows pinned scene ten lacks scene-swarm-add
description: scripts/test_run_ui_flows.py test_scene_setup_panel_selects_exactly_the_ten fails on main: the manifest panel row also selects scene-swarm-add, the pinned ten does not list it. Fix shape: add scene-swarm-add to the pinned list (or take it off the row).

title: scene-two-panes flow red at split default
description: Flow scene-two-panes fails at its last assertion on lane/gizmo-render-modes: after the split double-click the strip sits at y=400, the flow expects 424. Root cause unknown; the tree content is 268 px tall in the same state where the earlier World-row assertion passes, so 424 looks unreachable and the flow may already be red on main (not checked against a main build). Suspects: the Lane 20 split follow-up or the 2026-10-21 scene object model landing changed the tree rows. Fix shape: run the flow on a main build, then re-record the expectation or fix the tree height.

title: scene-fluid-authoring flow asserts Domain Size absent, stale since 4eaac147f
description: scripts/ui-flows/scene-fluid-authoring.json step 10 asserts Domain Size count 0, but commit 4eaac147f put the Domain Size row back as a Setup row. Red at base a53314510, independent of the SceneNodeRef lane. Fix: drop or flip that assert.

title: Fire and smoke on the shared sparse grid, and solids that ignite and melt
description:
A gas solver on the same sparse tiles and the same pressure solver as GPU FLIP, with no particles. It carries velocity, smoke density, temperature (which gives buoyancy), fuel that burns into heat and soot, and vorticity confinement for swirl.

Rendering. The same per-pixel walk as direct level-set water, but accumulating density, light and self-shadow along the ray. Emission is coloured by temperature on a blackbody ramp. Heat haze is a post pass that bends the background by the temperature gradient. High-energy jets (blowtorch, jet exhaust) are fast, narrow, hot inlets in a thin unbounded domain, with the shock diamonds faked as a standing brightness pattern.

Coupling, all on the one grid, one-way and cheap. Water is a wall to the gas. Heat at the water surface makes steam and drives the bubble emitter. Water reaching fuel quenches it. Fire lights the water through the ray tracer.

Solids that ignite and melt: MPM phase change in the style of Stomakhin 2014. Particles carry temperature and conduct with the grid's temperature field. Above the melt point they switch from elastic solid to fluid (into FLIP water on the shared grid once APIC lands). Burning solids emit fuel and heat into the gas solver, and lose mass and char.

Depends on the water end-game sub-epics for measurement (BUG-l2h3.26, Measurement and tooling), memory (BUG-l2h3.28, Memory), timing (BUG-l2h3.29, Live timing and display) and rendering (BUG-l2h3.30, Rendering), and on the APIC bead BUG-l2h3.27.4 (APIC transfers on GPU FLIP) and the direct level-set rendering bead BUG-651ho.1 (Direct level-set rendering). Design spec to the design doc standard before any build.

Direction for the shared infrastructure: docs/GPU_FLIP_END_GAME_DESIGN.md (GPU FLIP end game).
notes: Liquid and Gas are separate kinds on one grid (D12). Conversion (boil, condense, ignite a liquid fuel) is a solver rule moving mass between them, never a kind change. Adding the Gas kind is a ruling change in SCENE_DOCUMENT_DESIGN section 1 ruling 4: one kind, one compiler module, one card entry.

title: Ocean drives the GPU FLIP tank's open faces, and the two surfaces blend at the seam
description: One-way forcing: sample the FFT ocean's height and orbital velocity along the sea face, and drive the inflow's level and velocity per tick; blend the two surfaces near the seam. OCEAN_SURFACE_DESIGN.md section 9 (Ocean to FLIP coupling) marks it out of scope tonight. Peter, 2026-10-06 22:08: woah so they can blend seamlessly? And at 22:10: a wave into a wall and the scene extends out into infinite (to horizon) ocean? Pairs with the torus-axes bead in the Simulation sub-epic and with BUG-zdiuw (GPU FLIP infinite domain).

title: Whitewater grid passes over active tiles only
description: Free-performance class (direction doc section 4): it falls out of sparse tiles. The whitewater step's grid passes should visit only the active tiles the solver already lists, as the solver's own passes do. Check the whitewater passes one by one and move each to the tile list. Measure against the fresh frame split.

title: Whitewater: spread free pool room across emitters
description: Today free pool room goes to low-index emitters first. BUG-imy3.7 (whitewater pool full: replace oldest) notes: the emitter-fairness half is not built, and with replacement it only bites when one frame spawns more than the whole pool.

title: Camera inside GPU FLIP water: underwater fog, refraction of the surface from below
description: Same deferred row as caustics (FLUID_ENGINE_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md:601). Underwater fog, and refraction of the surface seen from below. Comes after the water-under-the-ray-tracer bead. Assumed in the programme at priority 3 (direction doc section 6 item 4, Peter's call).

title: Caustics from GPU FLIP water onto floor, walls and bodies
description: Nothing exists yet; the Caustics preset is a 2D pattern generator. Deferred row in FLUID_ENGINE_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md:601 (recursive refraction, caustics and underwater rendering). Industry methods: ray-traced photon or caustic-map splatting from the water surface. Comes after the water-under-the-ray-tracer bead. Assumed in the programme at priority 3 (direction doc section 6 item 4, Peter's call).

title: Display history slots hold sparse grids and particles, not meshes
description: Free-performance class (direction doc section 4): it falls out of direct level-set rendering (D2). The display ring copies the mesh per slot today. Once the water is drawn from the level set, each slot holds the sparse grid and the particles, and history costs the water's size and not the mesh's. Waits for the direct level-set rendering bead in the Surface sub-epic. Reports memory against the budget.

title: Half-precision storage for grid fields a pass only reads; solve stays f32
description: Direction doc D5: 16-bit is storage, never arithmetic. Grid fields may be stored as f16 where a pass only reads them. The pressure solve, and anything that accumulates, stays f32. The 2D texture sims quantised because the whole state lived in f16 across steps; here particles are the state and the grid is rebuilt every step. Prove each field against f32 before it ships, and report the memory saved against the budget.

title: GPU FLIP: 16-byte particles (tile-relative u16 position, f16 velocity), proven against f32
description: Direction doc D5. FluidParticle is 32 bytes (particles.rs:82). At 2.7 M particles at 128 that is the largest per-water memory term once the box is sparse. Position becomes a 16-bit integer offset inside the particle's tile, about one eight-thousandth of a cell. Velocity in f16 can add noise through the FLIP delta, so it is gated by the long-run agreement gate BUG-0cbzb (GPU FLIP default has no long-run agreement gate): if a resting pool jitters, velocity stays f32 and the particle is 24 B. APIC adds an affine matrix per particle (36 B at f32, 18 B at f16), so size this together with the APIC bead. Evidence: same seven-lever list, item 2; answer: not done.

title: GPU FLIP pressure: compute rows on the fly instead of storing them per level
description: Today the multigrid rows are assembled once per level and stored. Matrix-free (McAdams 2010) computes them on the fly, drops that memory, and often runs faster at large sizes. Evidence: Peter's seven-lever list of 2026-10-18 10:06, item 4, and the lead's answer that it is partly done and the memory saving is not fully there. Reports memory against the budget in the Memory sub-epic.

title: Decision: headline target, 128 at 60 fps display with sim at 30 steps a second on the M4 Max, plus 512 overnight export
description: Direction doc section 6 item 1, Peter's call. The direction doc assumes the headline is 128 at 60 fps display with the sim running at 30 steps a second on the M4 Max, plus 512 as an overnight export. On 2026-10-06 22:14 Peter said he did not think 128 at 60 fps would happen on this machine. The answer sets the priority of BUG-jyot (GPU FLIP at 128 for 60 fps) and whether tall cells ever reopen (D11). The paper estimates in direction doc section 5 are rewritten from the fresh measurement (D10), so decide with those numbers in hand.

title: Tie the pressure solve tolerance to what is visible
description: Free-performance class: fewer passes (direction doc section 4). Stop the pressure iterations when the remaining error is below what can show in the picture or change the motion, instead of at a fixed tight tolerance. Must keep the settled pool settled: check it against the long-run agreement gate BUG-0cbzb (GPU FLIP default has no long-run agreement gate) before it ships. The 900-round cap is a separate question, see BUG-bfal6 (900 cap raised p95 2.4 ms).

title: GPU FLIP: torus axes for endless channels and ocean tiles
description: Deferred row in GPU_FLIP_PRESSURE_SOLVE.md section 10: wrap-around (torus) axes. The endless-ocean scene is asked for, and multigrid wraps with periodic transfers. Peter asked on 2026-10-06 22:10 for a wave into a wall where the scene extends out into an infinite ocean to the horizon. Pairs with BUG-zdiuw (GPU FLIP infinite domain) and with the ocean-feeds-the-tank bead in the Instrument sub-epic.

title: Trigger-shape commits pay the trigger catalog projection
description: SetLayerClipTriggerCommand declares Effects for every non-sensitivity edit, so a trigger-shape commit runs the trigger catalog projection (work-trigger-shape FrameAlloc ceiling went 3108 to 3226 in UI_INVALIDATION P7c). Fix: declare Effects only for edits that change which trigger sources or targets exist; shape-only edits are Shapes.

title: Initial Fill refusal (mesh or non-Cube) is not named by the domain setup warning
description: Symptom: a mesh or non-Cube Initial Fill shows its error only on the fluid role source node; the GPU FLIP and Matter domain silently holds on a pending role with no setup warning of its own. Root cause: fluid_role_source.rs fail() marks the role output pending, so the domain sees only "a wired role is not ready" (read_roles) and cannot name the refusal. Fix shape: the role source publishes the FluidRole with a refusal reason (an Option<Arc<str>> on FluidRole, 37 constructors in the workspace) instead of failing; take_initial_fill returns it as Err and the domain refuses through setup_report.refuse and ctx.error like a rotated column. Also: when all 64 role inputs are taken, initial_fill.rs migration drops the old column with log::warn only (practically unreachable). Found in the lane/water-column-fill review.

title: Swarm body size: compact 1.5 m cloud or a bigger looser one?
description: Lead default: the retuned swarm (attractor 20 plus outward radial spring 20, Wind 0.5) holds a compact cloud about 1.5 m across under stock gravity for 60 s; a bigger body needs a weaker spring and sags more. Peter judges whether it reads as breathing. Evidence: docs/evidence/scene_setup_2026-10-20/swarm_hold_{0,10,60}s.png on lane/swarm-add-menu.

title: Regroup leaves modifier scopes stale; duplicate under AllObjects frame-needing modifier is rejected
description: From BUG-aszjq (typed identity) design 2.6. (1) Regroup does not update modifier targets, scene or mesh_frames scopes, so preparation fails with MissingTarget (group_edit.rs, groups.rs). (2) Duplicate leaves an AllObjects modifier that needs mesh frames (Shatter, Math View) without a frame for the copy, and frames.rs:226 rejects the graph. Root cause: scope paths and frame lists are not rewritten by those edits. Fix shape: both edits rewrite SceneNodeRef scopes and add a mesh frame for the copy.

title: Role pose history keyed by slot survives rebuild; reaction offset missing from matches()
description: From BUG-aszjq (typed identity) design 2.3. Two engine latents. (1) A role pose history is keyed by slot and not cleared on rebuild, so a role reusing a freed slot may get a one-tick velocity kick (manifold-water-liquid bodies.rs:656,786). (2) The coupling reaction offset counts collider roles and matches() does not compare that count, so an in-flight impulse could reach the wrong body when a collider role is added (coupling.rs:82-97,261). Both unconfirmed by repro. Fix shape: clear history on rebuild; add the collider count to matches().

title: Derive compound_materials at compile from part sources
description: From BUG-aszjq (typed identity) design 2.3. rigid_body.part_k wires and the compound_materials table rows [slot, material_index] are one fact stored twice; sync_group_physics_compound rewrites both, but a re-import that reorders glTF materials keeps a stale material_index. Fix shape: derive the table at compile from the part sources so table and part_k cannot drift. Sites: manifold-editing physics.rs:417-438, manifold-water-rigid physics_mesh.rs:23, fluid_role_source.rs:706.

title: Gizmo group drag skips unplaced objects
description: BUG-mqgsi (Blender-style selection): a member with no transform yet (ShapeWrite::Unplaced) is left out of a group move, turn or scale; a single drag places it first (place in crates/manifold-app/src/scene_gizmo.rs). Fix shape: place every unplaced member in the same composite before the group gesture begins, as one undo step.

title: Gizmo group scale: a turned box scales along its own axes
description: BUG-mqgsi (Blender-style selection) group scale writes each member box size on its own axes (selection_writes in viewport_gizmo/selection.rs). Blender scales a rotated member along the group axes, which shears it; our boxes cannot shear, so a turned member in a per-axis group scale grows along its own X, not the world X. Uniform scale matches Blender exactly. Fix shape if it matters on stage: map the group axis into each member frame and split the scale across its sides.

title: Opening replay after a seek reads a late live hop differently by frame rate
description: Symptom: after a seek, an audio-modulated physics param at the opening replay sample reads the first hop at 30 fps but the frame composed value at 144 fps when the producer first hop after the seek arrives after the opening replay. Found in the Speed on sim ticks verify (verify_speed_ticks_final.md round 5). Root cause: live hops arrive on wall-clock time; the backfill can only use hops already delivered. Same class as the wall-clock live audio gap in LIVE_SIM_CLOCK_DESIGN.md D4 Not covered. Fix shape: transport-mapped audio producers deliver the hop at or before the target before the opening replay runs, or the opening sample waits one hop.

title: Picker thumbnails for the starter scenes
description: Water in a Photoscan, Rubble Pile and the swarm starter ship without preset picker thumbnails. Generate them with the existing thumbnail path once BUG-rvmhf (double tone-map) is fixed, so the water thumbnail is not too dark.

title: render-generator-preset tone-maps twice for presets that tone-map in-graph
description: Symptom: water presets render too dark through render-generator-preset (stock Dam Break too). Root cause: the tool always applies its own tone map, so presets with an in-graph tone map get it twice; fluid_capture handles it and the thumbnail path only does when asked. Fix shape: one tone-map decision shared by both tools, read from whether the preset's graph tone-maps.

title: FLIP lattice limit refusal has no snapshot to show on card or gizmo
description: FLIP lattice-limit refusal happens in the extent walk before the domain computes, so no FluidDomainSnapshot carries it: the setup check cannot put it on the card or gizmo (MPM Grid Budget does reach them). Fix shape: have the extent walk publish its refusal on the snapshot path, or run the domain check before the walk. Found in B3 fix pass.

title: Setup warning for a shape with no card row shows on its owning object's card
description: After B3 (scene setup check), a problem shape with no card row bound to any of its params shows only as a red viewport box; the card gets no line. Fix shape: put the warning line on the owning object's card through the same RowSpec.setup_warning path, under its first row. Review: review_b3.md (scene setup programme notes).

title: Harden the integrates_time capability: refuse pure plus integrates_time, one threshold, trace export hop stamps
description: From the D2 verify (verify_d2_fix3.md). Three points. (1) Nothing stops a primitive declaring pure: true and integrates_time: true together, which would freeze the gusts again; add a const assert in primitive! (crates/manifold-node-engine/src/primitive.rs:126-133). (2) A test-only copy of the 1e-9 backward-seek threshold is left at live_sim_clock_reference.rs:275; read clock::BACKWARD_SEEK instead. (3) The turbulence drift sees impulse observation times the solver clocks do not; a fire stamped later than the next frame would restart the gusts mid-show. Today's stamps cannot do it, but nobody has traced whether export hops stamped with timeline time are bounded by the export frame. Trace it and pin it with a test.

title: rt_capture.rs:494 unused cmd_tx warning under ui-snapshot and perf-soak features
description: Symptom: building manifold-app with the ui-snapshot and perf-soak features warns about an unused cmd_tx at crates/manifold-app/src/rt_capture.rs:494 (on main, no lane diff), so clippy -D warnings with those features fails. Root cause unknown; suspect a cfg split that leaves the sender unused in that feature mix. Fix shape: gate or use the binding under the right cfg.

title: gpu_proofs_gate cannot run GPU proofs that live in the app binary
description: selection_outline::gpu_proof (A3 domain grid, gizmo handles, outline) are unit tests inside the manifold-app binary. gpu_proofs_gate.py only passes --lib or --test, so it fails with 'no library targets found in package manifold-app' and takes no GPU lock; lanes run them by hand through gpu_queue (cargo test -p manifold-app --features gpu-proofs --bin manifold -- selection_outline::gpu_proof). Fix shape: a --bin target in the gate and its landing mapping, so the landing gate maps app-binary proofs too.

title: Dev renderers render old shows without the app load steps
description: perf_soak, export_repro, rt_capture and rt_dynamic_held_out load .manifold files without prepare_loaded_project (crates/manifold-app/src/project_io.rs), so old shows render without the app migrations, and their output can differ from the app. Fix shape: route them through prepare_loaded_project.

title: Two-label float switches on modifier cards lack the T/D/A modulation lane
description: Symptom: a float param with two labels draws as a switch on inspector modifier cards and the Scene tab, with no T, D or A buttons, so it cannot be modulated, while pick lists keep the lane (wave 2 F6). Not a regression; main is the same. Fix shape: one rule, any modulatable float row keeps its lane whatever its display kind, built by the shared button-row builder (WIDGET_TREE_DESIGN section 5b).

title: Lay drifting force fields on the GPU for big lattices
description: A force field that moves every tick (Wind with Turbulence above 0) is laid again on the CPU every tick. After the D2 review fixes the fill is threaded (8 threads above 32k nodes): 0.96 ms a tick at water resolution 128, but about 6 ms at 256 (300k nodes) and at swarm Force Detail 64 (262k nodes). Shape: evaluate the FieldValue program (analytic leaves, sampled grids as textures) in a compute kernel through manifold-gpu that writes the force lattice directly, with the CPU fill kept as the reference twin. Timing tool: crates/manifold-physics/examples/force_fill_timing.rs. Found by D2 industry force set lane.

title: graph-tool validate cannot check a standalone scene-force recipe
description: Symptom: graph-tool validate on any scene-modifier preset (RadialForce, Wind, Attractor, Explosion) reports MissingScene, plus a dead-slider error for the fire trigger, which is wired through sceneModifier.impulses. Root cause: unknown; suspect validate expands scene modifiers only against an owner graph with a scene and its dead-slider lint does not read impulse bindings. Fix shape: validate --kind scene-modifier against a stock host scene, and teach the lint the impulses route. check-presets and the scene_force_presets test are the working checks today. Found by D2 industry force set lane.

title: Whitewater spray does not feel wind
description: Wind (node.wind_field, Air Resistance) drags FLIP, MPM, swarms and rigid bodies toward the wind velocity, but advect_whitewater reads only the push channel of the 8-float force lattice, so spray and foam ignore wind on stage. Shape: whitewater advect applies force_lattice_drag_step like move_swarm, with an Air Drag on the whitewater stage (default 1). Found by D2 industry force set lane.

title: Scene graph transaction undo entry holds four graph copies
description: Each insert or remove through SceneGraphTransaction keeps expected, before, candidate and committed graphs in its undo entry; for big imported scenes that is heavy on memory across the undo stack. Shape: keep before and committed only and check staleness by the owner graph structure version (PresetInstance.graph_structure_version) instead of a full expected copy. From review_b2a F11.

title: Scene insertion test gaps from the B2a review
description: Gaps (review_b2a F9): the P2 design names physics_boundary_redo_keeps_ids and physics_boundary_save_reload_modulate (PHYSICS_ENGINE_BOUNDARY_DESIGN section 6 test table) but neither exists, so a test(physics_boundary_redo)|test(physics_boundary_save) filter matches nothing; skin on the Add Plane template lost its test when layer_plane.rs went (skin_source_attaches_to_plane_base_color_and_undoes); scene-panel-tree and scene-panel-tree-physics flows now end on an Add menu snapshot instead of adding a light. The no-free-role-inputs refusal is now tested in core scene_template (B2b). Shape: add the two named tests against InsertSceneTemplateCommand, a plane-template skin attach plus undo test, and extend the two flows to click an entry.

title: Second quick Add-menu insert is refused as stale
description: Symptom: two Add menu inserts clicked within about two frames: the second is refused with the toast "Scene graph changed while preparing this edit". Root cause: SceneGraphTransaction prepares each insert against the UI copy of the project, and the first edit has not reached the UI copy yet, so the second sees a stale owner. Fix shape: prepare the transaction on the content thread against the live project (or re-prepare on stale instead of refusing), so quick repeated adds both land. Found in review of B2a (F8).

title: Thin objects can lose their selection outline over a fine mask
description: Symptom: with a 4K output in a small preview, a wire or thin rod can show a broken or missing selection outline. Root cause: the outline pass (selection_outline.rs OUTLINE_WGSL) takes 32 taps at 1 and 2 outline widths in screen pixels over a mask much finer than the screen, with no mips, so sub-pixel coverage is missed between taps. Fix shape: sample a max-reduced mip of the mask at the screen footprint (or dilate the mask once at screen resolution) before the edge test.

title: Scenes inside an effect get no selection outline in the editor viewport
description: Symptom: select an object of a scene that lives inside an effect graph and open the graph editor viewport: handles draw, but no selection outline (D-102). Root cause: the effect path never writes a viewport mask; scene_viewport_capture.rs generator_layer returns None for effect targets and observe_effect (content_pipeline.rs) writes no mask. Fix shape: the effect compositor gets the same set_scene_viewport_selection_mask and scene_viewport_selection_mask pass-throughs GeneratorRenderer has, and observe_effect writes the viewport mask into the mask bridge and stamps its frame. The main preview hosts generator layers only, so it is unaffected.

title: GPU proof scope reaches force_lattice.wgsl users by filename, not by include
description: scripts/gpu_scope.py _map_wgsl finds a shader users by searching for its file name. The shared crates/manifold-nodes-physics/src/shaders/force_lattice.wgsl reaches the FLIP and MPM proofs only because comments in gpu_flip_step.wgsl and the matter_*_body.wgsl files name it. It never reaches the whitewater proofs, which take it through the FORCE_LATTICE constant in their wgsl_includes. The same held for liquid_field.wgsl before the move. A change to the lattice include can land without its whitewater GPU proofs. Fix shape: shader_users follows the include, mapping a WGSL file to the Rust constant that include_str!s it and then to every primitive that names that constant in wgsl_includes or concatenates it, so comments no longer decide which proofs run.

title: UI flow expected-fail list does not pin the failing step
description: Symptom: scripts/run_ui_flows.py expected-fail list (scene-forces-controls, known red BUG-gm08t) accepts the flow failing at any step, so when the Add menu force labels changed to "Force — X" the flow failed earlier at the menu click and still counted as the expected red; the real regression was hidden. Root cause: the expected-fail entry names a flow, not the step and failure it expects. Fix shape: an expected-fail entry carries the step index (or assert text) it expects to fail at; failing anywhere else is a red.

title: FieldValue CPU wire registration lives in water-rigid
description: FieldValue (manifold-physics VectorField wire) is registered as a CPU wire type in manifold-water-rigid, but swarms in manifold-nodes-physics sit below the liquids and read it too. nodes-physics unit tests need a test-only CpuWireRegistration to run. Move the registration to the crate that owns the type or to nodes-physics so every reader below the liquids gets it without water-rigid linked. Found by E1 swarms fix lane.

title: Effect card body has no colour row branch
description: Symptom (latent): build_effect in crates/manifold-ui/src/panels/param_card/render.rs sends every non-Number row kind to build_button_row and never skips colour tails. Since BUG-9rai8 (Scene tab cards draw by kind) Scene tab cards are Effect-kind and draw by kind, so RowKind::Colour is reachable there. A force or object modifier that exposes a grouped RGB colour would draw its R row as a switch-styled button, G and B as loose sliders, and a click sends ParamToggle, snapping red to 0 or 1. No force or object modifier has colour channels today. Root cause: the effect and generator bodies keep two row loops; only build_generator has the colour row (build_generator_colour_row) and the is_colour_tail skip. Fix shape: one shared row loop for both bodies (parent vs no parent, x offset, font size, driver-column reservation as parameters), so colour, button and slider rows are decided once. Test: an Effect card with rgb_members hosted SceneTab draws one colour row.

title: Move rigid-body and force-field nodes into the physics nodes crate
description: Peter ruled (scene setup programme D-98, BUG-8gjbd scene setup programme epic) that a new physics nodes crate holds the shared force grid GPU side and the swarm nodes. The rigid-body nodes and the vector-field nodes still live in manifold-water-rigid, a crate named after water that is not water-specific. Fix shape: move them into the physics nodes crate with the move-identity gate (scripts/move_identity_check.py), then retire or rename manifold-water-rigid. Physics then lives in one place with a clean boundary.

title: Guard FORMER_RECIPE_LABELS against a future relabel
description: crates/manifold-core/src/param_lookup.rs FORMER_RECIPE_LABELS is a hand-kept list of every label a scene-modifier recipe has shipped (scene setup programme D1, 9cb47bc5e); a future relabel that skips it would freeze the old label as a fake user rename on load. Fix shape: a test that pins each recipe control current label and fails when one changes without its old label being added to the list.

title: GPU FLIP closest-body pick can steal a cut face from an unevenly scaled open body
description: Symptom (by reading): gpu_flip_step.wgsl:847-853 picks the closest body by capped world distance; on an open-mesh body scaled more than about 2:1 unevenly the cap drops under one cell and the open body can take a cut face velocity from the body that cuts it. Root cause: the band cap is in local units scaled by the smallest axis. Fix shape: compare uncapped or per-body-normalised distances. From the scene setup programme C1 verification (BUG-8gjbd).

title: Open-mesh water solid: scale hysteresis and worker threads outliving tests
description: Scene setup programme C1 (33ad9b0fb on lane/open-mesh-solids): the open-mesh lattice plan keys on scale in eighth-octave steps, so a scale swinging back and forth across a step midpoint alternates between two plans and rebuilds each swing. Fix shape: hysteresis on the step choice. Also one nextest run marked a test leaky (lattice worker threads outliving the test); a clean rerun passed. Fix shape: join or drop the worker on LiquidBodies drop so tests and project switches never leave a build thread behind. BUG-8gjbd, scene setup programme epic.

title: Old-project forces without host cards get no gizmo
description: Scene setup programme B1 fix (d1e1baa52) looks force shapes up by preset type, so forces saved before shape declarations get their gizmo, but only when the host layer has cards bound to the force params. Load reconciles cards for Math View only (project_io), not forces; the test mints them with reconcile_scene_modifier_parameters first. Unknown whether real old projects ever lack force cards. Fix shape: check a real old project with forces; if cards can be missing, reconcile force cards on load the way Math View does. BUG-8gjbd, scene setup programme epic.

title: Escape cancels a knob or gizmo drag and restores the value
description: Today Escape, focus loss and closing the editor commit a knob scrub and a gizmo drag (the scrub has no cancel step; scene setup programme B1/A1, BUG-8gjbd scene setup programme epic, made gizmo drags the knob scrub, D-70). The timeline restores on Escape, Blender cancels a transform on Escape. Fix shape: one cancel step in the scrub gesture that restores the value at Begin with no undo entry, used by the knob and both gizmo hosts. Also from the A1 review: a resize-seam press leaves preview focus so W/E/R stay captured; the preview passes a release with no press to the UI.

title: Object gizmo scale ignores mesh bounds and uses the parent axes
description: Symptom: the scene object box handles size from scale params without the mesh bounds, and scale handles orient on the parent axes rather than the object own axes. Pre-existing (unchanged by scene setup programme B1, BUG-8gjbd scene setup programme epic). Fix shape: the box shape for node.scene_object multiplies size by the mesh bounds the SceneVm already traces, and scale handles use the object local axes. Found by the B1 review.

title: Gizmo cannot turn a direction made of node params (blocks a turnable Initial Fill plane)
description: scene_gizmo.rs (~223) refuses a Rotate whose direction params are node params rather than card params, so a plane or axis declared on a node through the shape declaration (PHYSICS_ENGINE_BOUNDARY_DESIGN.md section 5.2) cannot be turned. Matters once BUG-q1ukb (Initial Fill level handle) or any node-declared axis lands. Fix shape: the multi-param scrub accepts node-param targets the way the single unbound node drag does. Found by the scene setup programme B1 review.

title: One N-param card scrub gesture: fold ParamRgb and ParamTriple into one
description: scrub.rs now has three param gestures: ResolvedScrub::Param, the material-only ParamRgb and the new ParamTriple for gizmo direction drags (scene setup programme B1, BUG-8gjbd scene setup programme epic). ParamTriple lacks Param touch-to-select automation and ParamRgb preset-type guard. Fix shape: one N-param card gesture with one undo entry that all three use. Found by the B1 review.

title: Build the gpu-proofs examples in a gate
description: encode_replay_probe and cinematic_tail_cost (crates/manifold-nodes/examples) build only with --features gpu-proofs, and no gate builds examples, so they can stop compiling unseen. Also fluid_capture.rs:1240 collapsible_if under clippy --examples --features gpu-proofs (may already be red on main). Fix shape: a cheap check leg that builds examples with gpu-proofs.

title: Keep one real-show engine tick smoke test?
description: After the 2026-10-20 trims no test drives a saved show through PlaybackEngine (the Burn V5 engine_tick tests were deleted as obsolete; transport arithmetic stays covered by frame_exact_transport.rs). Option: a few hundred stub-renderer ticks on the remaining Liveschool load. Cost: one more fixture-dependent test. Peter decides.

title: Test generator-side param id resolution and the loader generator identity fix
description: resolve_for_generator (generator drivers, envelopes, Ableton mappings) and the Ableton-mapping call sites in crates/manifold-core/src/project/load_migration.rs share the tested resolve_against, but their wiring has no test; nor does the loader calling reconcile_generator_identity (crates/manifold-io/src/loader.rs:468). Untested before the 2026-10-20 test trims too (the fixture tests could not reach them). Fix shape: small in-code projects through the loader.

title: Perform-mode quit prompt freezes UI redraw while it is open
description: While the native quit prompt is up, winit dispatches no redraws (handler in use). If the output depends on the UI thread to present, it freezes until the prompt is answered. Still better than the old instant quit. Needs one live look by Peter on stage; fix shape if it matters: keep presenting from the content side while a modal is up. Found by the daytime review of BUG-akqgc (quit loses unsaved changes).

title: Gate-scope follow-ups: smoke rule comment, plugins/ readiness mismatch, describe wording
description: From the batch 6 review of 0107d12db. (1) gate_policy.py:88 says a smoke proof must read no files; the real rule is no smoke test reads Rust sources at runtime or launches another workspace binary; nothing enforces it. (2) Any unowned non-.rs path (.beads, scripts) restores smoke everywhere, so pruning rarely fires at landing; gate_readiness drops analyzer paths before planning but gpu_proofs_gate.changed_paths keeps them, so passes on a plugins/ branch do not reuse (time only). (3) describe() says harnesses that link X but X is observer packages; codex_checks.py:134 reports final_filters() with smoke for harnesses that skip it; a missing rg raises FileNotFoundError uncaught in gpu_proofs_gate (loud, not silent).

title: UI-flow rows: colour-row and pane code on shared files selects no subsystem flow
description: After the BUG-bkfv2 (split bulky gate scopes) re-split, edits to scene_setup_panel.rs (build_properties_block composes the colour row), scene_setup_panel/parameter_navigation.rs (reveal opens the colour fold), param_slider_shared/row_host.rs (colour fold state) and scene_setup_panel/outliner.rs (owns scene_setup.objects.group_toggle) no longer select scene-colour-row-hex, scene-light-swatch or scene-two-panes. Follows the pinned-sentinel rule on purpose. Fix shape: move colour-row composition into colour_row.rs, or give those files narrow rows.

title: Automation lane mute: build the toggle or delete the flag
description: Automation lane mute: the flag and the command exist and playback honours the flag, but nothing in the UI sets it, and the inspector only reads it. Options: build the toggle (a mute button on the lane title), or delete the command and the flag. Peter decides when he can see it in the app. Source: simplification census decision 17 (BUG-g98wz).

title: patterns-029: RT accel probe prints are read by the rt_instancing GPU proof
description: Census row patterns-029 says the MANIFOLD_PROBE_RT_ACCEL prints in the RT accel code are set by nothing; wrong: crates/manifold-nodes-scene/tests/gpu_proofs/rt_instancing.rs:704-713 sets MANIFOLD_PROBE_RT_ACCEL=1 and reads the probe log. Deleting the prints breaks that proof. Fix shape: give the proof a direct counter or return value from the accel build (no env probe, no per-frame env read), then delete the prints; verify with that GPU proof through gpu_queue. Skipped in the overnight 2026-10-19 patterns continuation lane (039bd5b52).

title: Scene tree heading restyle and card collapse-all: two small tidy-ups
description: From the overnight batch 5 review of lane 18 (c) 952ba23a4 and (e) 86a7c8175. (c) outliner.rs restyle_as_heading depends on the header band being build_section_header's first node and finds the title by its text; give build_section_header a heading-style parameter instead, and check the header hover colour still reads over color::HEADER_BG. (e) set_card_sections_folded on a scene card sends one CardSectionFolded MutateProject per section; one mutate over the changed sections is tidier (harmless today: content drains and reacts once).

title: Transport tooltips allocate on every relayout
description: Lane 18 93b5dd825 (DRAW/RESTORE ALL tooltips) writes node.tooltip = Some(help.into()) for both buttons on every TransportPanel relayout (crates/manifold-ui/src/panels/transport.rs apply_tooltips). The frame plan runs relayout whenever a shown transport value moves (play state, BPM text, Link/clock state), so a drifting Link tempo allocates two Strings per relayout. Fix: give chrome View a tooltip field set at build, or write the tooltip only when it differs.

title: Scene tab readout rebuilds the authored graph itself and hides a failed projection
description: Lane 18 d07bef8af (BUG-l2itk, Lattice readout ignores the Resolution card) builds the Scene tab SceneVm in crates/manifold-app/src/ui_bridge/projection/inspector.rs (~165) from its own clone of the layer graph run through project_authored_params. When that returns None it falls back to the raw graph without a word. The viewport uses fluid_domain_edit::authored_def, which resolves the graph its own way and fails instead, so on a failure the two can disagree with nothing logged. It also clones the whole graph def twice on the failure path, and no cure-test came with the fix. Fix: call authored_def for both, log when the projection fails, and add a test where a Resolution card value differs from the saved node literal and the readout shows the card value.

title: One split-handle widget for the app splits and the Scene tab split
description: Every split in the UI is hand-rolled: the video/timeline split (layout.rs timeline_split_ratio, ui_root split_handle_id with set_split_handle_hover and friends), the inspector width, the Audio Setup dock handle, dock.rs seams, and now the Scene tab tree/settings split (scene_setup_panel/panes.rs, lane 20). Each repeats the strip, the idle/hover/drag colours, the drag maths and the double-click reset. They also drift: layout.rs eases its reset back to the default (snap-back animation), while the Scene tab split jumps. Design one split-handle component (ratio, clamp, default, eased reset, cursor) that all of them use.

title: Rack bypass records its old state from the UI copy
description: Symptom (read, not run): crates/manifold-app/src/ui_bridge/rack_controls.rs dispatch_bypass reads the enabled flag from the UI project copy and builds ToggleGroupCommand(old = UI value, new). ExecuteOnContent does not touch the UI copy, so a second click before the snapshot arrives sends a second command with the same old/new. The result is an extra undo step that changes nothing; and when the UI copy is stale, an undo can restore a state the performer never saw. The command sets rather than flips, so the rack never flips twice. Fix: have the command record old from the project when it executes on the content thread (the same pattern as SetGroupCollapsedCommand, which takes no old value), and send only the wanted state.

title: Chrome slider build and inspector tab-to-target mapping are each written twice
description: Lane 24 (rack bypass and wet/dry, 1560882f0) added chrome::materialize_sliders in crates/manifold-ui/src/chrome/diff.rs. Its BitmapSlider::build call (line ~128) repeats the ChromeHost slider build (line ~248) argument for argument; one fn building a slider slot from (rect, SliderSpec) should serve both. It also added rack_target in crates/manifold-app/src/ui_bridge/rack_controls.rs, another copy of the InspectorTab::Master => EffectTarget::Master else Layer mapping already written out in dispatch/params.rs (~498, 509, 775, 959) and ui_bridge/mod.rs resolve_effect_target. Fold these into one helper.

title: Scene tab tree/settings split: save it with the project and ease the reset
description: The Scene tab's split between the tree pane and the settings pane (crates/manifold-ui/src/panels/scene_setup_panel/panes.rs, lane/overnight-scene-two-panes) is UI-local: it resets to 0.4 of the body on every launch, and a double-click on it resets instantly. The app's other splits save through ProjectSettings (inspector_width, timeline_height_percent: app_lifecycle.rs save, autosave.rs UiStateStamp, change/audit.rs ViewPrefs fingerprint, ui_root apply_project_layout) and ease back on double-click (layout.rs reset_timeline_split, D15 snap-back). Fix shape: add scene_tree_split to ProjectSettings with a -1 default, write and read it at those four places, and give the reset the same eased tween. Not done in the lane because it changes the project format (manifold-core) outside the lane's files.

title: project_tool project new still starts on System Default
description: crates/manifold-app/src/bin/project_tool/timeline_verbs.rs project_new (~line 210) builds Project with ..Default::default(), so a project made from the CLI (this includes generated label projects) stores no device and opens the system input. File > New and the startup project use AudioSetup::for_new_project() since lane 19 (audio defaults, ee337be2e), which stores None (layers only). Fix: set audio_setup: AudioSetup::for_new_project() in project_new, plus a project_tool test that reads the device back. Better still, give Project one constructor for a brand-new project that all three call, so the next new-project path cannot miss it.

title: Scene card reveal misses a channel inside a folded colour row
description: Symptom (read, not run): ParamCardPanel::reveal_param (crates/manifold-ui/src/panels/param_card/state.rs ~293) unfolds the section and the card but not a colour row fold (lane 17, one colour row). When a reveal targets the G or B channel of a colour the user folded on the scene card (for example clip-trigger navigation via clip_response_rect), that slider is not built, so param_row_rect returns None and the jump lands nowhere. The Scene tab already does this through RowHost::open_colour_of in parameter_navigation.rs. Fix: call self.row_host.open_colour_of(&self.rows, param) in reveal_param. A modulated colour opens by default, so this only bites after the user folds one by hand.

title: Material Alpha Mode pick list reads Opaque on first draw and Solid after a rebuild
description: Symptom: in the Scene tab, a glTF material's Alpha Mode pick list shows 'Opaque' when the object is first selected, and 'Solid' after any rebuild of the material section (seen after a fold click; headless renders on lane/overnight-one-colour-row cebcbdfd6, gltfscene, object QS1694-W02-1-1, renders17 cr_material_after 04 vs 07; main f7fa40bbf also shows 'Opaque' on first draw). Same value, two label sets. Root cause unknown; suspect: material_inspector.rs (~701) overrides alpha_mode labels to Solid/Cutout/Fade (61b52dcef) in one draw path, while the lane 14 pick-list path (ff49632e2) on first build reads the node's own labels Opaque/Mask/Blend from pbr_material.rs ALPHA_MODES. Fix shape: one home for the label override (the projection, so every path draws the same labels), then a flow that selects the object, rebuilds, and reads the same label both times.
notes: Root cause (batch 5 reviewer, from code on main f7fa40bbf): build_properties_row (material_inspector.rs:649-650) swaps alpha_mode labels to Solid/Cutout/Fade only on its local info clone; value sync (scene_setup_panel/value_sync.rs:60 -> RowHost::push_button_value) labels from card.rows[i].spec, which keeps Opaque/Mask/Blend. First select builds Solid, first push rewrites it to Opaque; a rebuild with no value change skips the push and leaves Solid. Pre-existing on main, not lane 17. Fix: label override moves into the projection.

title: render_scene frame_setup.rs: frame_preliminaries doc comment sits above collect_object_draws
description: In crates/manifold-nodes-scene/src/node_graph/primitives/render_scene/frame_setup.rs:8 the BUG-trh7 (decompose render_scene.rs godfile) pass 0 doc comment (the frame preamble) is stacked on top of the pass 1 doc of collect_object_draws; frame_preliminaries itself has no doc. Pre-existing, carried unchanged by the pure-move pass. Fix: move those five lines above frame_preliminaries.

title: render_scene topology-before-consumer-flags order has no test since f442dd763
description: The BUG-trh7 (decompose render_scene.rs godfile) verdict required the source-order test rt_topology_validation_precedes_all_consumer_decisions to keep guarding that RT topology resolves before any per-draw RT consumer flag is written. That test was deleted in f442dd763 (WIP: integrate current-frame dynamic RT updates, 2026-09-17) together with the inline check it searched. Today the guarantee is only the call order in render_objects_frame: rt_accel_maintenance (render_scene.rs:2832) before author_rt_flags (:2845) at lane/overnight-render-scene-split 8c2ff9a1f. A late flag write would leave uploaded flags inconsistent with trace suppression. Fix shape: a behavior test (a topology-rejected frame uploads RT-off consumer flags) rather than a source-text search, or restore the source-order search against render_objects_frame. Needs a call on whether the guarantee is still wanted after the dynamic-RT rework.

title: render_scene per-frame Vec allocations: opaque_draws and rt_casters
description: Two per-frame heap allocations on the render_scene hot path (CLAUDE.md section Hot-path discipline), pre-existing, found during the BUG-trh7 (decompose render_scene.rs godfile) census: render_objects_frame collects opaque_draws: Vec<&ObjectDraw> every frame (render_scene.rs:2874 at lane/overnight-render-scene-split 8c2ff9a1f), and rt_trace_accumulate collects rt_casters: Vec<RtCasterParams> every traced frame (render_scene/rt_trace.rs:73). Fix shape: reuse scratch Vecs owned by RenderScene (opaque_draws holds borrows of draws, so it needs an index list or a cleared Vec of indices rather than references stored on self); casters is bounded by MAX_RT_CASTERS so an ArrayVec or fixed array fits. Behavior unchanged; measure nothing, it is a rule fix.

title: Graph-shape migrations skip scene-modifier graphs and group interface params
description: graph_loader::migrate_graph_shape runs Phong, sky sun (sky_sun::migrate_world_sun) and the box spawner (copies_body::migrate_world_copies) on def.nodes and nested groups only, but retire_params also recurses into def.scene_modifiers graphs and strips group interface params. A World sun or a Physics World box spawner inside a scene-modifier graph, or a group interface param that exposes a world copy param, is stripped without migrating. No bundled or known preset has either today. Fix shape: run migrate_graph_shape per scene-modifier graph, and retarget group interface params that target a world copy param to the copies body handle. Found by lane 26 (overnight 2026-10-19).

title: has_retired_params matches by node type, so every scene graph is cloned at each build
description: has_retired_params (crates/manifold-node-engine/src/load/graph_loader.rs:309) is true for any graph holding a node type listed in RETIRED_PARAMS, whether or not the retired param is present. Since lane 16 added node.bake_environment sun_x/y/z, nearly every scene graph (all bundled scene and water presets, every import) takes the owned-clone + retire_params path in instantiate_def and PresetRuntime::from_def_for_render on every chain build or freeze compile, a full def clone of large graphs for nothing. Not per frame. Fix shape: check that a listed param is actually stored, exposed, wired or bound (the shape sky_sun::carries_world_sun already uses), so current graphs stay borrowed.

title: Sky sun migration: notes when the disc was off, silent when a zero World sun turns the disc on
description: Symptom: migrate_world_sun (crates/manifold-core/src/sky_sun.rs) reports moved_off_light whenever the saved World sun points away from the Sun light, even when sun_disc_intensity was 0, so the load report carries a note for a change nobody can see. The reverse: a saved bake with sun_disc_intensity > 0 and an all-zero World sun (disc off before, degenerate direction) skips the note (length < 1e-6 continue) but still gets the sun wire, so the disc turns on at load with no note. Root cause: the note ignores the disc intensity. Fix shape: read the effective sun_disc_intensity per bake; note only when the disc was on, and add a note line when a zero-direction disc turns on. Found reviewing lane/overnight-sky-sun d807bfa7c.

title: Sky sun: hide or flag the sun disc rows when no Sun light feeds the bake
description: The environment bake paints its sun disc from the Sun light wired into its sun input (lane 16, overnight 2026-10-19). With no Sun light wired, or a Point or Spot light on that wire, Sun Disc Intensity and Sun Disc Size move nothing: a dead-state slider (DECOMPOSING_GENERATORS.md section 7 (no dead-state params)). Fix shape: a scene-table gate on the two disc rows keyed on whether the bake has a Sun light on sun, the same Gate machinery lane 15 used for EnvironmentMode. Related edge: switching the wired light from Sun to Point turns the disc off even when another Sun light exists, because the wire is only refilled on light add, light remove and load (manifold_core::sky_sun::wire_sky_sun).

title: Enum dropdown commits the label index, not min plus index
description: Symptom: a pick from the shared enum dropdown (RootAction::ParamEnumDropdown, opened by a scene pick list or a 3+ label value cell) writes ParamEnumSet(i as f32) in crates/manifold-app/src/ui_root/dropdowns.rs, while the readout, the pick list label and the 2-label cycle all read index = value - min (label_index in crates/manifold-ui/src/panels/param_slider_shared/state.rs). Any labelled param whose range does not start at 0 would commit the wrong value. Root cause: ParamEnumDropdown carries labels and current_index but not min. Every scene choice today has min 0 (checked over PhysicsBoxes, PhysicsSolids, WaterDamBreakGpuFlip, Ocean), so nothing is wrong on stage yet. Fix shape: carry min on ParamEnumDropdown and commit min + i. Found by lane 14 (draw by kind), overnight 2026-10-19.

title: Scene gates: one evaluator for card and Scene tab (card ignores Gate::Only)
description: Symptom: a light param gated Gate::Only (cone angles on a Sun, falloff on a Sun) that is pinned to the card because it is attached shows on the card at full strength with no reason, while the Scene tab dims it with "This light type does not use it". Root cause: gate evaluation is split. scene_card.rs scene_card_rows (crates/manifold-app/src/ui_bridge/projection/scene_card.rs:53-60) handles Dim/Fold and falls through on Only; build_item_properties (crates/manifold-ui/src/panels/scene_setup_panel.rs ~1610) handles Only and ignores Dim/Fold. Fix shape: one foundation-side evaluator, e.g. fn gate_state(gate, switch values) -> Shown | Dimmed(reason) | Left out, called by both surfaces, so INV-S8 (same label on both surfaces) has a same-state twin. Also consider ControlGroup::starts_folded() instead of the Advanced title-prefix string test in material_section_folded. From the batch 4 review of lane/overnight-light-env-gates (02fe7c42b).

title: Card: dim a pinned row its light type does not read
description: Gate::Only (lane overnight-light-env-gates) is evaluated per item in the Scene tab only. The card (manifold-app scene_card.rs) ignores it, so a user-pinned Outer Cone Angle on a Point light shows undimmed. FeatureSwitches there is card-global, so it needs a per-owner mode read like the Scene tab one.

title: Hide Softbox bake rows while the importer environment is on HDRI
description: The importer environment is switch_texture choosing between bake_environment (Softbox) and hdri_source. node.switch_texture is not in the scene table (nodes-scene scene_surface.rs), so with HDRI selected the World item still shows the bake rows, which nothing reads. Fix shape: give the selector a scene-table row with switch Feature and gate the bake rows on it with Gate::Only, the mechanism lane overnight-light-env-gates added.

title: GraphCanvas view_version bumps on events, not only on visible change (D19)
description: Since f8299d689, GraphCanvas::view_version (crates/manifold-ui/src/graph_canvas/mod.rs) feeds the editor CompositeKey. Several bumps fire on the event whether or not the drawn state changed: every left press (interaction.rs on_left_button_down), every press while the popover is open (popover_on_left_press), every popover typed char, backspace, commit and cancel, set_collapsed with an unchanged value (mod.rs), and every release that ends a drag. UI_INVALIDATION_DESIGN.md D19 requires view_version setters to compare before bumping. On those paths the counter is the deleted offscreen_dirty write moved inside the canvas. Nothing is missed and the work equals the old behaviour, but the extra composites stay. Fix: compare before bumping on each path, or key the composite on a Copy view tuple (pan, zoom, cursor, hovered, selection length, drag kind, popover state).

title: Display retarget resume writes offscreen_dirty by hand: prove it redundant or name its input
description: app.rs, the display-retarget resume (display_retarget_pending cleared) sets ws.offscreen_dirty = true, from 3bdeea4ae (force a fresh render so the UI is not stale). During the transition tick_and_render does not run; on resume the planner compares the last applied inputs, and the UI composite reads no EDR headroom or display state (rg edr|headroom over frame/present.rs, ui_frame.rs, app_render.rs finds nothing), so the cached offscreen should still be the right pixels and the write looks redundant. Not deleted in lane/overnight-repaint-planner because the only oracle is a live display change (projector plug or move to an external screen), which has no headless path. Fix shape: one live check with the write deleted; if the UI stays right, delete it; if not, the missing input is the display the offscreen last composited for, keyed like Workspace::composited_size.

title: Untrimmed video clip with a slow decoder open plays behind the playhead until drift correction
description: Symptom: an untrimmed video clip started on its beat whose decoder takes longer than 0.1 s to open plays from the file head, behind the playhead by the open time. Drift correction (2 s cadence, DRIFT_CORRECTION_THRESHOLD 0.1 s) then seeks it, which shows as a visible jump. Root cause: since f16ee9c01, check_preparing_clips in crates/manifold-playback/src/engine.rs decides whether to seek from the start lag measured at clip start, not from the playhead at the ready tick. That restores the timing from before 71478fb33 on purpose, so untrimmed cuts are not hidden while a seek lands. Fix shape: on the ready tick, also seek when expected video time minus decoder position exceeds DRIFT_CORRECTION_THRESHOLD, and pair that with the fix for BUG-t02zk (a seek over 100 ms can flash the file head) so the seek does not flash.

title: Stale comments still name arms of Application::handle_text_input_commit
description: Since e8f70ee71 (one typing path), handle_text_input_commit only builds the dispatch context and calls text_session::commit; it has no per-field arms. Comments still describe its arms: crates/manifold-app/src/ui_bridge/project.rs:1247 and :2893 (SceneObjectRename arm), ui_bridge/mod.rs:37 (re-export rationale), ui_bridge/state_sync.rs:219, docs/UI_WIDGET_UNIFICATION_DESIGN.md:327 and :626 (per-field command routing). Fix: point each at text_session::commit or delete it.

title: UI flow steps cannot open automation-point, graph-editor or save-preset text fields
description: Lane 8 (one typing path) moved the commits of AutomationPointValue/Time, GraphGroupRename, GraphStringParam, GraphWgsl, GraphNumericParam, GraphNodeSearch, GraphTableCell and SavePresetName into text_session::commit. No flow step can open these fields: their begin lives on Application (automation_point_input::begin_value/begin_time, window_input graph canvas, editor_bridge save prompt), not in text_session::begin_for_action, so the ui-snap runner has no way to start the session. Covered by text_session unit tests instead. Fix shape: move each begin into begin_for_action (needs the watched graph in the runner for the graph kinds), then add flows.

title: rt_capture.rs leaves cmd_tx unused after the queued-command fix
description: Symptom: building manifold-app with features ui-snapshot,perf-soak warns: unused variable cmd_tx at crates/manifold-app/src/rt_capture.rs:495 (let (cmd_tx, cmd_rx) = crossbeam_channel::unbounded). Seen on batch 2 tip bff8bd875. Root cause: 01b96ef67 (BUG-vli73, queued commands keep arrival order) changed load_project_and_warmup to take the receiver; the sender is no longer used, so the channel is a placeholder. A feature-gated clippy -D warnings run on manifold-app would go red. Fix shape: name it _cmd_tx or keep the sender alive with a comment saying why (a dropped sender disconnects the receiver, which may change warmup behaviour; check which before renaming).

title: Decomposition designs still describe relight as live
description: RENDERER_RUNTIME_DECOMPOSITION_DESIGN.md (relight satellites in bindings.rs, apply_relight_params), MODEL_COMMAND_DECOMPOSITION_DESIGN.md (relight.rs row), UI_FUNNEL_DECOMPOSITION_DESIGN.md and CAPABILITY_ROADMAP.md (deferred relight atoms) still mention relight. Left as history; trim when next touched.

title: Depth-companion machinery has no reader after relight deletion
description: Relight deletion left DepthRule (crates/manifold-node-engine/src/scene/depth_rule.rs), the required depth_rule field on every primitive and EffectNode (PrimitiveSpec::DEPTH_RULE, EffectNode::depth_rule) and SourceHeight with no reader now that relight_augment is gone. Fix shape: delete the trait method, the macro field, the enum and every depth_rule line in one mechanical sweep. Also three WGSL comments still cite the deleted DEPTH_RELIGHT_DESIGN.md (heightmap_to_normal.wgsl, heightmap_to_normal_body.wgsl, gradient_central_diff_body.wgsl); left because editing a fused body may change codegen text.

title: effect-development skill still teaches the EffectFactory and inventory registration flow, which no longer exists
description: The registration section of .claude/skills/effect-development/SKILL.md describes EffectFactory and inventory registration; EffectFactory is gone from the code. Found by the overnight 2026-10-19 deleted-API doc sweep (not caused by tonight). Fix shape: rewrite the section to the current registration path (rg the live effect registry), or point at docs/ADDING_PRIMITIVES.md.

title: Typed pre-1.11 readers that are not version-gated still compile in
description: After the 1.11.0 load floor (lane 27), the JSON ladder below 1.11, param_storage_v14 and the V1.0 flat fields are gone, but typed readers for pre-1.11 shapes remain because they are not version-gated and can in theory meet a 1.11+ file: legacy paramIndex parking and resolve_legacy_param_ids (driver, envelope, Ableton, macro serde; the registry-missing path re-emits paramIndex on save), integer Unity preset discriminants (legacy_discriminant), macro layerEffect/param_index targets, reconcile_generator_identity (fallbacks-003), the userParamBindings stub-graph completion in node-engine binding_migration (fallbacks-009), per-clip effects kept skip_serializing in clip.rs, and V1 plain-JSON migrate_duration_modes (fallbacks-008). Corpus at 0291dac8f: 0 of 75 files at 1.11+ carry paramIndex, layerEffect, param_index, userParamBindings or integer type ids. Fix shape: per reader, prove no 1.11+ writer can produce the shape (the paramIndex re-emit is the one live writer), then delete it with its tests; the alias-rename half of resolve_legacy_param_ids serves 1.11+ files and stays.

title: Video import into a project with no layers silently does nothing (paste, drop and Cmd+I)
description: Symptom: start_video_import returns None when the project has no layers (app_lifecycle.rs, or_else first layer then ?), so a pasted, dropped or Cmd+I video into an empty project does nothing and says nothing. Before the overnight 2026-10-19 lane 22 fix (d182c3be3) the paste path created a Video layer (but played black). Also input_host.rs:1528 overwrites import_failures_rx, so a second import started while one is probing loses the first one probe failures (pre-existing in import_video_files). Fix shape: create a Video layer when none exists, in start_video_import, so all three entry points share it; keep a list of failure receivers or one shared receiver.

title: Leftovers from lane 10 process-layer deletions
description: Delete .claude/hooks/cargo-check-on-stop.sh (unwired; worker seats cannot delete under .claude/hooks by shell). Strip stale mentions of land_wave.py, detect_unverified_compound_landing_merge, flow_gate_guard and the flow-gate marker from docs/AGENT_ROUTING.md line 37 and .claude/GIT_TREE_DISCIPLINE.md lines 38, 45, 99-100, 288.
notes: Doc part done on lane/overnight-rule-sources: AGENT_ROUTING and GIT_TREE_DISCIPLINE stale mentions stripped. Remaining: delete .claude/hooks/cargo-check-on-stop.sh (Peter).

title: Binding lookup by numeric node id can pick the wrong node inside groups
description: Symptom: node numbers repeat across group scopes in 43 saved projects while two docs claim they are unique. Root cause: crates/manifold-core/src/effects/bindings.rs:289-300. Fix shape: scope-aware lookup and fix the two false docs (effect_graph_def.rs:111, scene_object_migration.rs:144). Source: docs/evidence/simplification_census_2026-10/REPORT.md (bug 25, patterns review). Found by the BUG-yn979 (Simplification pass) census; read from code, not reproduced.

title: Clip triggers compute a conditioned value every audio hop and throw it away
description: Root cause: crates/manifold-playback/src/live_trigger.rs:250-256. Fix shape: delete with patterns-033. Source: docs/evidence/simplification_census_2026-10/REPORT.md (bug 16, patterns-033). Found by the BUG-yn979 (Simplification pass) census; read from code, not reproduced.
notes: Overnight 2026-10-19 lane 23 found the discarded computation is not side-effect free: ClipTriggerFollower::sample calls cfg.shape.condition(raw, dt, &mut smoothed, &mut prev_raw), and condition (manifold-core/src/audio_mod.rs:367) writes prev_raw, which the next hop rate-of-change edge reads. Fix shape: update prev_raw directly and drop only the unused smoothed update, after confirming smoothed has no other reader. Left for a decided pass; cost per audio hop is small.

title: Worktree acquire blocks for minutes while it deletes idle slots build caches
description: Symptom: scripts/agent-worktree.py acquire ran over 5 minutes before handing out a slot, deleting 205k files (30G) in idle slot-6/target. The lane waits the whole time. Root cause: acquire and release both scrub the whole slot pool toward a fixed SCRUB_TO_GB = 40 GiB total, least recently built slot first, synchronously, whatever the free disk (193G free at the time). With ten slots at 20-30G of build cache each, the pool is nearly always over 40G, so almost every acquire deletes some idle slot cache, and the next lane in that slot then builds cold. Fix shape: remove the pool scrub from acquire and release; free-space pressure is already handled by the landing gate reclaim, which works against the real free-space reserve. Each slot owner keeps cleaning its own slot at release.

title: Attach click intents to nodes at build time
description: Panels register click intents in a separate repopulate pass using NodeIds they held from the build, which is how stale ids leaked onto live nodes (Kick Size firing the Orbit drawer). The registry is now keyed by full NodeId so stale ids are inert, but the stronger fix is registering intents when a node is created, stored with the tree and cleared with its region, as the chrome ChromeHost already does (chrome/diff.rs). Large: every panel intent path moves into build and UITree must carry a generic action type. Design pass first.

title: Inspector chrome scopes still match nodes by bare slot
description: inspector/routing.rs in_range for master_chrome, layer_chrome and clip_chrome compares slots only, ignoring NodeId generation. Safe today only because every inspector build clears all three ranges. Fix shape: store the first node as a NodeId and use UITree::range_owns, like the five panels converted in lane/stale-intent-ids.

title: Automation lane title: click re-enables an overridden lane
description: docs/AUTOMATION_LANES_DESIGN.md describes a per-lane re-enable click on the lane header for overridden lanes; it was never built. Today restore is the lane menu or RESTORE ALL. The new right-edge title is the natural place: clicking it while overridden restores that lane.

title: Automation lane title: left-click reveals the param in the inspector
description: The new right-edge lane title (lane/automation-header) ignores left-click. The only reveal path today is reveal_trigger_response for clip-trigger cards. Needs a card-by-target finder plus inspecting the lane's layer.

title: Arrangement insert time and delete time
description: Arrangement editing, not automation: Insert Time shifts everything at or after a time selection later by its length; Delete Time removes the span and pulls later material back, splitting straddling clips. Live keys Cmd+I and Shift+Cmd+Delete. Deferred by Peter 2026-10-15. Unreviewed WIP is parked on local branch lane/automation-time (18a03af25), mixed with the follow-clips work.

title: Automation reach: selection scale/stretch, master and group lanes, log scale
description: No vertical scale or time-stretch handles on a selection; no lanes for master effects or group layers (ui_bridge/projection/timeline.rs ~110, 359); no log scaling for frequency-type params (linear normalisation in slider.rs ~688-694).

title: Automation follows clips when clips move
description: A system on top of current automation: moving clips in time carries that layer's automation inside the clip span with them (Live's default, with a Lock Envelopes toggle). Not part of the lane editing UX epic. Deferred by Peter 2026-10-15. Unreviewed WIP for this and insert/delete time is parked on local branch lane/automation-time (18a03af25).
notes: Deferred by Peter 2026-10-15 (not needed yet). Unreviewed WIP parked on local branch lane/automation-time (commit 18a03af25): clippy clean, tests not run.

title: Recorded take subtracted when its live start was cut off reads one low
description: From BUG-0xwux review. A recorded take whose live start the binding cutoff dropped is still subtracted from the arrangement step count, so the stepped value reads one low until the next seek. Very rare. Fix shape: subtract only takes whose live start was actually counted.

title: live_clips grows over a long live set without stop
description: From BUG-0xwux review. live_clips Vec only empties on seek/stop; record_start contains (clip_controls.rs:277) and each rebuild take match grow linearly over a long unstopped live set. Per live start and per edit, not per frame. Fix shape: id-keyed set, or prune takes once promoted.

title: manifold-io bundled solve-level label test red after Coarse Solve rename
description: Symptom: manifold-io solve_level_card_v1180::injected_pieces_are_the_bundled_defs_verbatim fails on main since 2a55ca1df renamed the bundled label to Coarse Solve. Root cause: the test pins the old bundled label text. Fix: update the test expectation (or derive it from the bundled def) after confirming the rename was intended.

title: objc2 encoding checks allocate every frame in dev builds
description:
objc2 0.6 verifies every message's type encoding when debug_assertions are on, which allocates (NSString labels, dispatch_compute_grid, new_command_buffer): about 14 allocations per frame on the content thread in a dev build of an idle show. Release builds have none. The UI_INVALIDATION P6 live idle trace (MANIFOLD_WORK_TRACE=1 prints nothing for 10 s) can only pass in a build without them.
Options: set [profile.dev.package.objc2] debug-assertions = false in the workspace Cargo.toml (keeps our own debug asserts, loses objc2's encoding checks in dev), or enable objc2's disable-encoding-assertions feature, or run the trace only on a release build. Measured with cargo --config 'profile.dev.package.objc2.debug-assertions=false': the per-frame objc2 allocations disappear.

title: UI runner stamps touches() instead of the executed set
description: ui_snapshot/script.rs ~937, 951, 2100, 2114, 2134, 2142 stamp touches()/peek_* rather than last_written; for ExecuteSelecting and SceneModifier it stamps before execute, missing AdmittedGraphCommand frame Effects (scene_modifier_edit.rs 613-623) and the lazy-instance set. Test-model gap only: make the runner stamp what execute returned, like EditingService.

title: Script runner: pointer gestures outside a work window run tweens in real time
description: The ui-snap script runner settles every tween after a Pointer gesture (live_frame settle_tweens=true at each pointer arm in crates/manifold-app/src/ui_snapshot/script.rs), even outside a work window, while Step outside a window runs real time and records filmstrip tiles. So a flow filmstrip of a click-started tween (the old inspector-drawer-filmstrip.json, deleted from the repo in d7d919753) shows only the settled state. Fix shape: settle on pointer gestures only while a work window is open, as Step does; check every flow that snapshots right after a click without a Step still passes, and restore a drawer filmstrip flow on a scene where a click opens a drawer (envmod, the Step action button).

title: Delete unused Compositor::graph_snapshot_for and outer_routings_for
description: crates/manifold-compositor/src/compositor.rs (trait, ~309 and ~321) and layer_compositor.rs (~3744, ~3752): no callers since the content thread builds the watched-graph snapshot from the registry in crates/manifold-app/src/graph_snapshot.rs. Delete both trait methods and impls; check rg graph_snapshot_for and outer_routings_for return nothing after.

title: UI runner: canvas graph edits, editor text fields and editor shortcuts
description: After BUG-12iyh (UI runner drives editor window, perform mode and text input) the ui-snap runner drives editor pointer input through crates/manifold-app/src/editor_input.rs and gets the real watched-graph snapshot via graph_snapshot.rs, but these still live on Application and fail loudly in the runner: the canvas graph-edit loop in app_render (SetGraphNodeParam, MoveGraphNode and the other GraphEditCommand arms except SetNodePreviewNormalize), graph editor text fields and Save Preset (text_session leftovers), editor keyboard shortcuts other than popover typing and Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z, the viewport gizmo press and drag (runner has no ViewportSession), and the App-side preview bookkeeping in present_graph_editor_window (SetGraphPreviewNode, SetNodeAtlasVisible). Fix shape: move the graph-edit loop and editor key handling into editor_input.rs as Application-free seams the App and runner share; then a canvas node-param drag flow can replace the card-lane drag in work-node-param-drag.

title: Water item shows Whitewater Budget and Physics View under Transform
description: Symptom: in the Scene tab, the Water item lists Whitewater Budget and Physics View (node 107) under the Transform group. Root cause unknown; suspect the scene table does not describe those params, so they fall into the fallback group. Fix shape: describe them in the scene table with their real group (Simulation / Setup).

title: Delete the unreachable New 3D Scene empty-state button
description: Since the Scene tab shows only on scene layers (D16), the New 3D Scene empty state in scene_setup_panel.rs:1441 and its action (actions.rs:245) cannot show. Decided: new scenes come from the generator selector (Scene preset). Delete the button, its action and arm, and the test that asserts it.

title: Set slider range opens a text box, not a range popover
description: P8 (BUG-pmbd3.19) Set slider range opens the shared text box prefilled min to max because the mapping drawer range editor only lives in the graph-editor window. D15 asked the popover to reuse the drawer range editor. Typed commit is untested in the live app. Fix shape: host the drawer range editor in the main window popover.

title: Dead unprefixed pos_ range widening in material_inspector.rs
description: material_inspector.rs around :622 matches unprefixed pos_ ids to widen position ranges to scene bounds; real ids are prefixed (23_pos_x), so it never fires. Delete it, or move the intent into the scene table limit if still wanted.

title: Material Alpha Mode label reads Opaque then Solid after any rebuild
description: Symptom: in the Scene tab material Opacity & Cutout section, Alpha Mode reads Opaque when the tab first builds and Solid after any rebuild (a plain SetParam on pos_y triggers it). Root cause unknown; suspects: first build and rebuild take the enum label from different sources (declared value labels vs saved choices). Fix shape: one label source through the lookup.

title: Switch and trigger rows on the scene card have no right-click menu
description: Symptom: right-clicking Depth of Field, Motion Blur or a trigger row on the scene card shows no menu, so Remove from Card and Show in Scene tab are unreachable for them. Root cause: generator toggle and trigger rows skip param menu registration (existing skip in RowHost). Fix shape: register_param_menus covers toggle and trigger rows too.

title: Card section title spells a model name differently from the Scene tab
description: Symptom: on gltfscene the card section title reads cc0__oomurasaki_azalea_r._x_pulchrum while the Scene tab tree and item header read cc0_oomurasaki_azalea_r_x_pulchrum. Root cause unknown; suspect the card title comes from the saved stamp section string while the tree uses the item readable name (D11 humanising). Fix shape: the card section title reads the owning item name from scene_items (INV-S8 one name per item).

title: Imported glTF light position rows show no unit
description: Symptom: in the Scene tab on gltfscene, the imported Sun light Position X/Y/Z read 5.00 with no unit, while a native scene light reads 0.00 m. Root cause unknown; suspect the importer authors these as curated controls (D24), so they own their spec and do not inherit the node unit. Fix shape: curated node-bound controls inherit unit and limit from the node lookup like range (D22/D23), or the importer stamps the exact auto-stamp id.

title: Scene card: glTF scenes imported before P4 keep fan-out controls in the wrong place
description: Symptom: in a glTF scene imported before feat/scene-surfaces-p4, the environment intensity fan-out shows under a World section instead of Lighting, and the object Visible/Ambient fan-outs show on the card. New imports are right: the importer now writes each card fan-out its first target scene placement (gltf_import/scene.rs, fan_out_scene in scene_surface.rs). Root cause: fan-outs keep their own scene facts (SCENE_SURFACES D23), and saved imports carry none. Fix shape: a load rung in scene_exposure migrate_scene_exposures that fills scene on fan-out card params with no scene, the same rule the importer uses; idempotent. Also decide whether the importer table read counts as a lookup call outside the join (section 5 common rules); if so, move both into the load join as a fan-out rule.

title: land_pass_guard treats git push origin main and HEAD:main differently
description: A docs-only direct push (aed10f1d3, 2026-10-14) was denied as "git push origin main" and accepted as "git push origin HEAD:main". Docs-only pushes are allowed by rule, so one of the two forms is wrong: either the guard wrongly blocks the plain form for docs-only trees, or the HEAD:main form skips the ungated-tree check. Read land_pass_guard in .claude/hooks/preToolUseBash.py, make both forms take the same decision, add a test for each.

title: Transport jumps after an export started while playing
description: Symptom: after an export run while the transport was playing, the first live tick counts the export wall time as frames, so the playhead jumps forward by the export duration. Pre-existing (base did the same with wall dt). Fix shape: re-anchor the content frame grid when export ends. Found reviewing BUG-gqhep (live-transport-nondeterministic-frame-clock) P2.

title: Design structural sharing of project parts so an edit stops deep-cloning the whole project
description: Committed end state of UI_INVALIDATION_DESIGN.md section 9: every edit deep-clones the whole Project on the content thread (content_thread.rs send_state :1220) and again on the UI (app_render.rs:287). End state: Arc per Part, cloned only for parts whose stamp moved. Prerequisite: live values move out of Project (content_thread.rs writes them every tick), or every tick copies. Needs its own design doc after UI_INVALIDATION P6.

title: Re-key content work that keys on data_version or runs per command: render_all, tempo reconcile, trigger targets, graph snapshot cache
description: GeneratorRenderer::render_all marks every generator string params dirty and allocates a hash set on any data_version change (generator_renderer.rs:724). handle_command clones tempo_map on every Execute/Undo/Redo (content_commands.rs:791-797) and reconciles per command (:2228). trigger_targets.refresh keys on data_version (content_pipeline.rs:2359). graph_snapshot cache keys on embedded_presets_fingerprint (content_thread.rs:1543, :1571), which the design deletes. Fix shape: each becomes a reaction-table row keyed on part stamps (UI_INVALIDATION_DESIGN.md section 4).

title: SetFrameRate writes settings outside EditingService
